events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 80th birthday of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, born Farrokh Bulsara in Zanzibar in 1946.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Eighty years since his birth, the legend of Freddie Mercury continues to burn brighter than ever. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today, born in Akron, Ohio, in 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: 75 years young for the incomparable Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your go-to Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis icon and solo star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today, born in Manchester in 1972.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite tune from the man himself, whether it's Oasis, Beady Eye or solo?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: This month marks the 55th anniversary of John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine', which was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine 55 Years On
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as powerfully today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod 25 years ago today in 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: iPod at 25
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod turns 25 today! It changed everything for music lovers. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is Global James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and his six decades of cinematic adventures. What's your favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today, born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel mayhem, his comedic genius is truly unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, universally known as the 'White Album', was released 58 years ago today in 1968.

angles.name: White Album at 58
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, experimental 'White Album'. Which track from this masterpiece still gets you every time?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary lead singer of Queen, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we said goodbye to a true showman. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite memory of him?

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago today in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul at 61
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly pushed boundaries. What's your top track from this classic?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon in New York City in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost a visionary. John Lennon's message of peace and love lives on through his timeless music. What's his song that resonates most with you?
